faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for MCD Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications must reach the organisation by 20 November 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How do I apply for MCD Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Fill in the application form (Pro-forma (bio-data) enclosed with the notice, page 4) and send it to Office of the Chief Auditor, Municipal Corporation of Delhi, 27th Floor, Dr. S.P.M. Civic Centre, Minto Road, New Delhi-110002, by at the office address, or by e-mail, to reach by 20 November 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for MCD Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The maximum age is 62 years (as on last day of the receipt of the application).

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: It depends on the post: Last Pay drawn minus basic Pension and Transport Allowance for journey from residence to office and back equal to the serving officer/officers of same/equivalent rank, on which the officer concerned retired for Sr. Audit Officer, Last Pay drawn minus basic Pension and Transport Allowance for journey from residence to office and back equal to the serving officer/officers of same/equivalent rank, on which the officer concerned retired for Audit Officer, Last Pay drawn minus basic Pension and Transport Allowance for journey from residence to office and back equal to the serving officer/officers of same/equivalent rank, on which the officer concerned retired for Assistant Audit Officer.

faq.question: Q5. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Willing retired/retiring officers of the Office of the Chief Auditor, MCD; officers from the Finance and Accounts Department of MCD, the office of the C&AG of India and its subordinate offices, and other Departments/Organizations of Govt of India may also apply. The requirement for each post is in the eligibility table above.

faq.question: Q6. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Engagement is full time; no other assignment permitted during engagement. Must maintain office time, decorum and discipline as expected of a regular employee. May be called on Saturdays, Sundays and holidays without compensatory leave. Subject to the Indian Official Secrets Act, 1923 during and after the assignment.

faq.question: Q7. Who cannot apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Retirees aged above 62 years on the last day of receipt of application.

faq.question: Q8. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Initially six months from the date of joining. Extendable up to 5 years, six months at one go, at the discretion of the Municipal Chief Auditor. Not extendable beyond 65 years of age.

faq.question: Q9. Which places are covered by MCD Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Headquarters at Civic Centre, New Delhi, Any zonal office of the Municipal Chief Auditor.

faq.question: Q10. Which documents are needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Application in the enclosed pro-forma (bio-data); Copy of PPO; Two recent passport size photographs.
